name: Affiliatly
author: overcodebg

sections.description:
Affiliatly Integration for WooCommerce.

Affiliatly is a simple but powerful affiliate management software with a wide array of features available at an affordable price. Every plan comes with its full set of features and the only thing that differs with the higher plans is the number of active affiliates.

Affiliatly is fully customizable to fit your requirement, simple to set up and easy to use with no technical knowledge required. Our support team will solve your issues or even implement custom requirements. Track your referrals by link/QR, coupon, email, SKU, customer/order tags or a combination of those. Create your own commission structure, global or individually, for each affiliate.

Our core strengths:
* Cost-effectiveness and ability to boost website traffic and sales
* Super easy setup
* User-friendly interface
* Flexible management of affiliate rates and efficient royalty handling
* Reliable performance with effective sales tracking
* Top-level customer support. The team is frequently praised for being responsive and helpful.

Features

  • Custom branded affiliate portal
    For affiliates to check their earning, payments, update payment settings and to generate referral links for your products.

  • Auto-sync store order status
    Your order information and status will be updated in our system in a matter of seconds

  • Per product and per affiliate Commission
    Setup default commission for the whole site and/or set up different commissions for different products or for different affiliates. Exclude products from the program which have low margins.

  • Multiple Tracking Methods
    Track affiliate orders through referral links, coupon codes.

  • Link Sharing
    Affiliates can share their link and the coupon on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram, as well as in emails and web pages.

  • Two Tier affiliate program
    You can have two tier levels of affiliates. Set commission for each.

  • Marketing assets for your affiliates
    Provide all the base branding material for your affiliates to use it when creating content for your products

  • Payments in Bulk via PayPal
    Create a mass pay file from our Dashboard to easily pay in bulk on through PayPal.

  • Analytics for performance measuring
    Check accurate statistics of leads, traffic, sales and performance comfortably from our dashboard.

Feedback

  • We are open to your suggestions and feedback. Thank you for using or trying out our Affiliatly app!
  • Drop us a line at https://www.affiliatly.com/.

More

  • Visit the Affiliatly website.

External services

This plugin needs to connect to your account in Affiliatly.com in order to function correctly.

Once you setup and connect the current plugin with your Affiliatly account, information about the visitors on your site will be send to Affiliatly ( only if they have visited your site via referral link ) and information about the completed orders ( ID, price, bought products, customer email ) will be send to your account’s database in Affiliatly.com

This is required in order for the standard functionality of the Affiliatly app, the information is stored on our server only and its not shared with 3rd parties.

You can get more info here: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire ‘affiliatly’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Start by visiting plugin settings at WordPress > Plugins > Affiliatly Integration.

You can also check our video tutorial:
sections.faq:
What are Active affiliates

An affiliate with the status Active means an affiliate with an active/approved account in your program i.e. an affiliate who is actively promoting your store to potential customers.

Do you have free trial

After your 90 days free trial period, you need to choose a paid plan to continue using Affiliatly. You can learn more about our plans over here https://www.affiliatly.com/#pricing

How to get affiliates

We bring you the route to successfully grow your affiliate program with Affiliatly based in our experience, studies and what we’ve learned from the top performers of our community. Check it here https://affiliatly.helpscoutdocs.com/article/165-definitive-route-to-grow-your-affiliate-marketing-program

Which tracking methods are available

Our WooCommerce integration support tracking by Link, QR, Coupon, SKU and Email.

What is the Affiliatly marketplace

The Affiliatly Marketplace is our curated directory of merchants and their products. The marketplace helps your store and affiliate program get discovered by our affiliate network. You get more affiliates and our affiliates get more stores and products to promote. The best: it is absolutely FREE for everybody to join!
To join, you can check this guide https://affiliatly.helpscoutdocs.com/article/124-affiliatly-marketplace
